goal: Reproduce the local reference exact-counting algorithm and verify its time and space bounds.
scope: Finite reference Sections 3 and 4 checks, sparse admitted placements, independent component counts, disjoint replacement supports, finite connected Taylor contraction, finite members of the Lemma 4.8 parameter schedule, finite Section 5.1–5.2 sparse-system checks, a finite Section 5.3–5.5 replacement sum in A_ell, and finite Section 6 equation selection with disjoint sparsification, and finite Appendix D coefficient rings, CNF networks, Cauchy deformation, tapered Hermite recovery, collision parameter schedules, packet layouts and prospective child topologies. Proposition 6.4 does not claim an O_k(rho(n)) bound. Appendix D recursive contraction and Theorem 1.1 are not implemented; no general-input asymptotic claim.
